rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when the work is tedious or boring rather than physically tiring.

example.english: Looking at the same report every day is really wearisome.
example.traditional: 日日對住同一份報表，真係好悶。
example.jyutping: jat6 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 tung4 jat1 fan6 bou3 biu2 zan1 hai6 hou2 mun6

rows.note: Use this when the activity is tiring, demanding, or physically arduous, as with gardening work.

example.english: Digging in the garden all afternoon is really wearisome.
example.traditional: 成個下晝喺花園掘泥，真係好辛苦。
example.jyutping: seng4 go3 haa6 zau3 hai2 faa1 jyun4 gwat6 nai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this when the wearisome thing is troublesome or irritating, such as repetitive procedures or paperwork.

example.english: Having to fill out so many forms every time I apply is really wearisome.
example.traditional: 每次申請都要填咁多張表，真係好煩。
example.jyutping: mui5 ci3 san1 cing2 dou1 jiu3 tin4 gam3 do1 zoeng1 biu2 zan1 hai6 hou2 faan4
